spec_match.rationale: Runs identical 250ms blocks on both threads with each thread observing itself — the main thread's entry (LoAF since 123) is real and its duration/blockingDuration render from the actual entry; the worker column reports its own genuine state.

interactive.rationale: One button janks both threads; the parity table updates live per thread with a debounced final verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the measured gap; the table delivers it with real entries on the working side.

edge_cases.rationale: Worker zero-entry state is called out explicitly after each run; observer attach failures render per thread; repeat runs accumulate counts.

conformance.rationale: The suite's main-thread-jank and blocked-worker assertions are the two halves of this table.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: main thread produced 2 real entries (duration 253ms, blocking 203ms) while the worker produced none — the asymmetry measured live, narrated correctly; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts fire per main entry, per worker entry, and per completed parity run with both counts.

design_system.rationale: Entry counts colour emerald/rose with the numbers as the primary signal; table scrolls in its wrapper; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with scoped headers; status is aria-live and restates the verdict in words; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table scrolls inside .tbl-wrap; 0px page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Capture the parity-achieved verdict on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a supporting engine both columns should fill with comparable durations and the status should flip to parity-achieved.

guidanceConsulted.query: comparison table live counts screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep dual-thread comparisons in real table semantics with textual verdicts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scoped-header table plus an aria-live status that words the outcome.

guidanceConsulted.query: deliberate jank bounded once per click
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Bound induced jank to explicit user action.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the observability gap measured for real on Chromium 141 — genuine main-thread LoAF entries (253ms/203ms) against a silent worker for identical jank. Clean console at both viewports.
